CampaignStats.title: CampaignStats
CampaignStats.description: Tracks the permanent SUPPORTERS counter incremented by 1 when a user imports an image.

count.description: Total number of campaign supporters starting from 8739 and incrementing by 1 when a user imports an image.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest counter update.

CampaignConfig.title: CampaignConfig
CampaignConfig.description: Stores the active campaign PNG frame and branding/copy settings managed by the administrator.

frameUrl.description: Relative URL to the active transparent PNG campaign frame.

brandTitle.description: Header brand title displayed at the top-left.

campaignTitle.description: Primary campaign headline displayed on the editor page.

campaignSubtitle.description: Event location, date, or campaign tagline.

editorPrompt.description: Instructional subtext guiding visitors in the profile editor.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest configuration change.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who updated the campaign configuration.

GalleryItem.title: GalleryItem
GalleryItem.description: A public campaign profile picture uploaded by a visitor to the DMC Gallery.

imageUrl.description: Validated image path or Firestore chunk identifier for the composed campaign image.

supporterName.description: Optional display name provided by the supporter.

city.description: Optional city or district provided by the supporter.

fileSize.description: Validated byte size of the uploaded image (max 10MB).

chunkCount.description: Number of base64 image chunks stored in the chunks subcollection.

hasThumbnail.description: Whether a lightweight gallery thumbnail exists in chunks/thumb.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the image was uploaded.

ImageChunk.title: ImageChunk
ImageChunk.description: A bounded base64 chunk storing persistent gallery image bytes under the 1MB Firestore document limit.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator role document verified by Firestore security rules.

SupporterRegistration.title: SupporterRegistration
SupporterRegistration.description: Deduplicated supporter registration record ensuring each participant increments the supporter counter at most once.

/stats/{statId}.description: Publicly readable and atomically incrementable SUPPORTERS counter document (stats/supporters_v2).

/supporters/{supporterId}.description: Immutable, deduplicated supporter registration tokens bound atomically to stats/supporters increments.

/campaign_config/{configId}.description: Publicly readable, admin-writable active campaign configuration and frame settings (campaign_config/active).

/gallery_items/{itemId}.description: Publicly readable and creatable DMC Gallery items; only admins may update or delete.

/gallery_items/{itemId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Persistent image data chunks associated atomically with each gallery item.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Authorized administrator registry managed by the bootstrapped admin.
